invariants.rationale: style must be non-null for Label constructor to succeed, otherwise likely to cause NullPointerException.
Label constructor likely expects non-null text, as typically labels require a non-null string.
If text is not null, calling length() is safe and always yields a value >= 0.
LabelStyle likely requires a valid font for rendering labels.
If background is present, it should be of type Drawable as commonly expected in scene2d UI paradigms.
